name: Owned task collection CRUD
func: const jwt = global.get('jwt'); const pool = global.get('dbPool'); const auth = msg.req.headers.authorization || ''; if (!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { error: 'Missing or invalid Authorization header' }; return msg; } try { msg.user = jwt.verify(auth.slice(7), env.get('JWT_SECRET')); } catch (error) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { error: 'Invalid or expired token' }; return msg; } const userId = String(msg.user.id); const body = msg.payload || {}; const send = (payload, statusCode = 200, eventType = null) => { msg.statusCode = statusCode; msg.payload = payload; const event = eventType ? { payload: JSON.stringify({ type: eventType, userId }) } : null; node.send([msg, event]); node.done(); }; (async () => { if (msg.req.method === 'POST') { if (!body.title || typeof body.title !== 'string') return send({ error: 'title is required' }, 400); const result = await pool.query('INSERT INTO tasks (user_id, title, description, completed) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) RETURNING id, user_id, title, description, completed, created_at, updated_at', [userId, body.title.trim(), body.description || '', Boolean(body.completed)]); return send({ task: result.rows[0] }, 201, 'task:created'); } if (msg.req.method === 'GET') { const page = Math.max(Number.parseInt(msg.req.query.page || '1', 10) || 1, 1); const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number.parseInt(msg.req.query.limit || '20', 10) || 20, 1), 100); const result = await pool.query('SELECT id, user_id, title, description, completed, created_at, updated_at FROM tasks WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3', [userId, limit, (page - 1) * limit]); return send({ tasks: result.rows, page, limit }); } send({ error: 'Method not allowed' }, 405); })().catch(error => node.error(error, msg)); return;

name: Owned task item CRUD
func: const jwt = global.get('jwt'); const pool = global.get('dbPool'); const auth = msg.req.headers.authorization || ''; if (!auth.startsWith('Bearer ')) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { error: 'Missing or invalid Authorization header' }; return msg; } try { msg.user = jwt.verify(auth.slice(7), env.get('JWT_SECRET')); } catch (error) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { error: 'Invalid or expired token' }; return msg; } const userId = String(msg.user.id); const taskId = Number.parseInt(msg.req.params.id, 10); if (!Number.isSafeInteger(taskId)) { msg.statusCode = 400; msg.payload = { error: 'Invalid task id' }; return msg; } const body = msg.payload || {}; const send = (payload, statusCode = 200, eventType = null) => { msg.statusCode = statusCode; msg.payload = payload; const event = eventType ? { payload: JSON.stringify({ type: eventType, userId }) } : null; node.send([msg, event]); node.done(); }; (async () => { if (msg.req.method === 'GET') { const result = await pool.query('SELECT id, user_id, title, description, completed, created_at, updated_at FROM tasks WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2', [taskId, userId]); return result.rowCount ? send({ task: result.rows[0] }) : send({ error: 'Task not found' }, 404); } if (msg.req.method === 'PUT') { if (!body.title || typeof body.title !== 'string') return send({ error: 'title is required' }, 400); const result = await pool.query('UPDATE tasks SET title = $1, description = $2, completed = $3, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $4 AND user_id = $5 RETURNING id, user_id, title, description, completed, created_at, updated_at', [body.title.trim(), body.description || '', Boolean(body.completed), taskId, userId]); return result.rowCount ? send({ task: result.rows[0] }, 200, 'task:updated') : send({ error: 'Task not found' }, 404); } if (msg.req.method === 'DELETE') { const result = await pool.query('DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2 RETURNING id', [taskId, userId]); return result.rowCount ? send({ deleted: true, id: taskId }, 200, 'task:deleted') : send({ error: 'Task not found' }, 404); } send({ error: 'Method not allowed' }, 405); })().catch(error => node.error(error, msg)); return;

name: Validate websocket JWT
func: const jwt = global.get('jwt'); const query = (msg._req && msg._req.query) || (msg.req && msg.req.query) || {}; const token = query.token || ''; try { if (!token) throw new Error('missing token'); jwt.verify(token, env.get('JWT_SECRET')); msg.payload = JSON.stringify({ type: 'connection:ready' }); return msg; } catch (error) { msg.close = true; return msg; }

name: Refresh access token
func: const jwt = global.get('jwt'); const refreshToken = msg.payload && msg.payload.refreshToken; const secret = env.get('JWT_REFRESH_SECRET') || 'test-refresh-key'; const accessSecret = env.get('JWT_SECRET') || 'test-secret-key'; if (!refreshToken) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { error: 'refreshToken is required' }; return msg; } try { const claims = jwt.verify(refreshToken, secret); const accessToken = jwt.sign({ id: claims.id, email: claims.email }, accessSecret, { expiresIn: '1h' }); msg.statusCode = 200; msg.payload = { accessToken }; return msg; } catch (error) { msg.statusCode = 401; msg.payload = { error: 'Invalid or expired refresh token' }; return msg; }
